playStore.title: Better Keep: Private Notes
playStore.shortDescription: Private, offline notes with rich text and end-to-end encrypted sync.
playStore.fullDescription:
Write quickly without giving up rich formatting, offline access, or privacy. Better Keep is a local-first notes app with optional end-to-end encrypted sync.

CAPTURE AND WRITE
• Create notes, checklists, reminders, sketches, images, and voice recordings
• Format with headings, emphasis, lists, links, colors, and indentation
• Transcribe voice notes on supported devices with an on-device Whisper model

ORGANIZE WITHOUT THE CLUTTER
• Pin important notes and arrange them as cards
• Use labels, folders, colors, archive, trash, and fast search
• Keep original note timestamps and state during supported local imports

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Start taking local notes without an account
• Keep writing when the network is unavailable
• Encrypt note titles, content, and supported attachments before optional sync
• Review the documented security model and source-available code

AVAILABLE WHERE YOU WRITE
Use Better Keep on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web. Local features vary by platform; voice transcription is not available on Web.

BRING YOUR NOTES WITH YOU
Choose a supported Takeout archive inside Better Keep. Import processing stays on your device, exact repeat imports are skipped by default, and the final report calls out warnings or unsupported items.

The source is available under CC BY-NC 4.0. Better Keep has no published independent security audit. Download Better Keep and start with a local note today.
